description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and is responsible for displaying a list of test projects, initializing page arguments, setting up the GUI, and managing test project data and permissions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments related to test project actions and filters.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with test project data, user permissions, and page configuration.

methods.name: initIntegrations
methods.description: Adds status images for issue and code trackers to each test project based on their enabled state.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to modify the product.
